# the Forge by LevelUp

> The Forge is the residential arm of LevelUp Learning. Each program is a fixed block of days where a small cohort lives together and learns by doing: you build, write, shoot or ship something real with mentors, and leave with work you made.

The Forge is run by LevelUp Learning (registered as LevelUp Edu Pvt Ltd). Programs run for 6 to 15 days. Cohorts are between 20 and 32 people. Entry is by application. The fee covers stay, all meals, mentorship and tools; travel to the venue is not included. No prior experience is needed, and most participants are working professionals who take time off to attend.

Site: https://www.forgebylevelup.com/
Parent organization: https://www.leveluplearning.in/ (summary for assistants: https://www.leveluplearning.in/llms.txt)
Contact: forge@leveluplearning.in

## Programs

- [the Forge AI Residency](https://www.forgebylevelup.com/ai): An invite-only residency for founders, operators and business leaders. Five online sessions, then seven days on the ground, to ship a real AI product and an operations layer for your business. Fee: INR 1,50,000 (1.5L) for the 7 days, inclusive of GST. Dates and venue: https://www.forgebylevelup.com/ai/llms.txt
- [the Forge Filmmaking Bootcamp](https://creators.forgebylevelup.com/filmmaking): Write, direct and shoot your own short film in 15 days (7 days online, 8 days offline), with mentors who have been nominated for the Emmys and made Netflix originals. The fee varies by season and edition, roughly INR 85,000 to 1,05,000.
- [the Forge Creator Residency](https://creators.forgebylevelup.com/): An invite-only residency for founders and creators who want to build a personal brand through content on social media, making real content every day.
- [the Forge Writing Retreat](https://creators.forgebylevelup.com/writing): A 6-day residential retreat for screenwriters and authors, in a scenic destination, with bestselling authors and produced screenwriters as mentors. The fee varies by edition.

## What alumni leave with

- Filmmaking: a short film they made.
- Creator: real content and a personal brand system.
- Writing: a finished draft.
- AI Residency: a working product and a live automation.
